hook_text: Us raat Meera ki aankhon ke saamne
feedback: Great pacing and strong use of close-ups for emotional resonance. The cold open flash-forward works well. To improve further, ensure the silent transition cuts in the middle give enough breathing room for the tension to really land before the final twist.
lines: Us raat Meera ki aankhon ke saamne...
Train ke farsh par toote kangan bikhre the.
Raat ke teen baje, Thar Express registan cheer rahi thi.
Meera akele bed par baithkar apna locket sahlā rahi thi.
Agle hafte uski shaadi thi, par phone mein network nahi tha.
Tabhi samne wale berth par ek ajnabi aakar baith gaya.
Bhai, ye tunnel nahi, maut ka darwaza hai.
Samne kale andhkar se bhari tunnel aa rahi thi.
Meera ki battery khatam ho chuki thi aur train bekaboo thi.
Tujhse keh raha hoon, bahar kood ja!
Ek bhayanak jhatke ke sath sab kuch kala ho gaya.
Wo train koi safar nahi, ek beeta hua haadsa thi.
Agar raat ko aawaz aaye, toh peeche mat dekhna.
